issues.description: Path normalization contract between VitestGit/config.related and isIncluded is implicit and unenforced
issues.detail: isIncluded compares slash(cleanUrl(filename)) against this.changedFiles.includes(filename), but findChangedFiles and config.related are not guaranteed to return paths in the same normalized form. Mixed separators on Windows, absolute vs relative paths, or query suffixes silently filter everything out. Normalize changedFiles at assignment and document the precondition.

issues.description: globCache keyed only on filename, ignoring changedFiles filter state
issues.detail: isIncluded caches verdicts by filename with no dependency on changedFiles. Calls made before onTestRunStart fires (config resolution, plugin setup, pre-warm paths) poison the cache with unfiltered verdicts that survive the later clear. Either key on (filename, hasChangedFilter) or make the ordering invariant explicit and audited.

issues.description: CoverageProvider contract relies on optional onTestRunStart for correctness
issues.detail: onTestRunStart is declared optional on CoverageProvider, but BaseCoverageProvider depends on it to populate changedFiles. Custom providers that omit or override it silently lose filtering, and isIncluded's postcondition now depends on mutable state set by a sibling lifecycle method. Document the invariant or fold it into a non-overridable hook.

issues.description: Silent fallthrough when findChangedFiles returns null reports all coverage
issues.detail: When VitestGit returns null (not a git repo, bad ref), changedFiles stays undefined and coverage falls back to reporting every file. A user who asked for changed-only coverage gets full coverage with no warning. Fail loudly or warn explicitly.

issues.description: Three identical onTestRunStart call sites in core.ts invite drift
issues.detail: core.ts has three hand-pasted `await this.coverageProvider?.onTestRunStart?.()` lines after _testRun.start. The next code path that starts a run will silently skip coverage filtering. Fold into _testRun.start or a shared helper so the invariant is enforced in one place.

issues.description: CLI transform for `changed` handles boolean branches the parser never produces
issues.detail: The transform checks value === true and value === false, but CLI args arrive as strings. Either the boolean type is leaking from config into the CLI layer or the branches are dead. Narrow the input type to string and document precedence (boolean-literal coercion vs git ref), noting refs literally named true/false/yes/no are unreachable.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the feature is well-scoped with solid happy-path tests, but the file-path matching layer is fragile and under-specified. The dominant concern across all three reviewers is path normalization: changedFiles is compared by exact string equality against slash+cleanUrl-processed filenames, with no enforced contract between VitestGit/config.related output and isIncluded's expectations. Secondary concerns cluster around the globCache being keyed only on filename (ignoring changedFiles filter state) and the optional onTestRunStart hook being load-bearing for correctness. Torvalds adds a silent-fallthrough failure mode when git resolution returns null. Smaller cleanups: deduplicate the three onTestRunStart call sites in core.ts and tighten the CLI transform's input type.
